scenario: Native Release Pick & Place stress mode; randomized scenario sequence per fixed seed; 50 attempts per seed
limitations: Only seeds 1, 2, and 3 were tested, with 50 scenarios each. This sample is not a general success probability.
The stress output does not expose per-stage grasp, transport, placement, TCP error, collision-recovery, or timeout reason counts.
Difficulty bins were not independently configured or reported by this executable.
Attempt elapsed time includes mission processing in the stress harness and is not a real robot cycle-time claim.
